name: Technical Writer

sections.daily_work: Write documentation, user guides, and API references. Simplify complex technical concepts. Work with engineers to understand products. Edit and maintain help centers.
sections.learning: Writing and editing skills, understanding of software/technology, Markdown and documentation tools (GitBook, Confluence), basic coding literacy, user testing.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $45,000-$65,000 USD. Mid-level $65,000-$95,000. Senior technical writers can earn $100,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: English or communications degree, technical writing certificate, writing samples and portfolio, contributing to open-source documentation, tech-adjacent roles (QA, support) as a stepping stone.

try_in_real_life: Write a how-to guide for a tech task you know well
Contribute documentation to an open-source project on GitHub
Review a software product's help docs and note what's confusing
Research the Society for Technical Communication (STC)
sources: Society for Technical Communication salary surveys; BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook
